# ReverbSoundEffect

- Inherits [`SoundEffect`](soundeffect.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("ReverbSoundEffect")`

Adds the reverberation of a room, such as a hall, a cave or a bathroom.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Damping` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | How quickly high frequencies fade in the room, from 0 to 1. Use a low value for a stone hall and a high one for a carpeted room. |
| `DryLevel` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The level of the original sound, from 0 to 1. |
| `RoomSize` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | The size of the room, from 0 to 1. A larger room reverberates longer. |
| `WetLevel` | `number` | `0.3` | read/write | The level of the reverberation, from 0 to 1. |
| `Width` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How widely the reverberation is spread between the left and right channels. |
